
I would like you to reverse engineer a gate-level netlist back to its original RTL description.
The netlist was synthesized from a Verilog RTL design.

Please create an equivalent, clean, and readable RTL description that implements the same functionality.
Your RTL should be written in standard Verilog or SystemVerilog using best practices.

The module should be named 'TopModule' with the following interface:
clk, aresetn, x, z

Gate-level netlist:
```verilog
/* Generated by Yosys 0.51 (git sha1 c4b5190229616f7ebf8197f43990b4429de3e420, g++ 14.2.0-4ubuntu2 -fPIC -O3) */

module RefModule(clk, aresetn, x, z);
  wire _00_;
  wire _01_;
  wire _02_;
  wire _03_;
  wire _04_;
  wire _05_;
  wire _06_;
  input aresetn;
  wire aresetn;
  input clk;
  wire clk;
  wire [1:0] next;
  wire [1:0] state;
  input x;
  wire x;
  output z;
  wire z;
  NOT _07_ (
    .A(aresetn),
    .Y(_00_)
  );
  NOT _08_ (
    .A(state[1]),
    .Y(_02_)
  );
  NAND _09_ (
    .A(state[1]),
    .B(x),
    .Y(_03_)
  );
  NOR _10_ (
    .A(state[0]),
    .B(_03_),
    .Y(z)
  );
  NAND _11_ (
    .A(state[1]),
    .B(state[0]),
    .Y(_04_)
  );
  NAND _12_ (
    .A(x),
    .B(_04_),
    .Y(_05_)
  );
  NOT _13_ (
    .A(_05_),
    .Y(next[0])
  );
  NAND _14_ (
    .A(_02_),
    .B(state[0]),
    .Y(_06_)
  );
  NOR _15_ (
    .A(x),
    .B(_06_),
    .Y(next[1])
  );
  NOT _16_ (
    .A(aresetn),
    .Y(_01_)
  );
  DFFSR _17_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(next[0]),
    .Q(state[0]),
    .R(_00_),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
  DFFSR _18_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(next[1]),
    .Q(state[1]),
    .R(_01_),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
endmodule

```
